user.title: Zeeda EV Charger
user.description: Sign in with your ZEEDA app account.

data_description.username: The email is confirmed to work; phone number is best-effort.
data_description.timezone: The Zeeda regional server is chosen by this time zone. Defaults to Home Assistant's, but set your account's region if HA runs elsewhere (e.g. in the cloud).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Zeeda
reauth_confirm.description: The sign-in for {email} is no longer valid. Enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Zeeda servers.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data.scan_interval: Status poll interval (fallback to the real-time connection)

cloud_unreachable.message: Could not reach the Zeeda cloud: {error}. Home Assistant will retry automatically.

command_failed.message: Could not send the command to the charger: {error}

stop_not_confirmed.message: The charger did not stop charging in time, so the charging current was not changed.

current_not_applied.message: The charger did not apply {amps} A. The charging current was not changed.

charge_mode_not_applied.message: The charger did not apply the new charging mode.

invalid_current.message: {option} is not a charging current this charger accepts. Choose one of: {options}.

charger_offline.title: {name} is offline
charger_offline.description: The Zeeda charger {name} has not been connected to the Zeeda cloud for more than {minutes} minutes, so it cannot be monitored or controlled. Check that it has power and is connected to Wi-Fi. This message disappears on its own when the charger reconnects.

no_chargers.title: No chargers on the Zeeda account
no_chargers.description: The Zeeda account {account} has no chargers. Add your charger in the ZEEDA app with the same account, then wait a few minutes; this message disappears on its own when a charger shows up.
